sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，热身 v2-2：站姿颈-腕-指唤醒 45 秒（表：十指交扣腕绕 8 字；动画改合掌））

purpose.zh: 撑地和地板动作前，把脖子、手腕和手指轻轻活动开
purpose.en: Gently wakes up your neck, wrists and fingers before floor and hand-support work.

text.zh: 脖子半圈慢绕，只在前面绕，不往后仰
text.en: Slow half circles in front, never tip back

text.zh: 耳朵朝右肩，下巴经过胸口，再到左肩，来回慢慢绕。
text.en: Ear toward the right shoulder, chin past the chest, to the left shoulder, and back, slowly.

text.zh: 双手在胸前合掌，手腕带着手画横着的 8 字。
text.en: Press your palms together in front of your chest and let the wrists draw a sideways figure eight.

text.zh: 双臂前伸，用力握拳再把手指张到最大，重复几次。
text.en: Arms forward, make a tight fist, then spread your fingers wide; repeat a few times.

commonErrors.en: Rolling the neck fast or hard.

cautions.zh: 脖子发麻、头晕或疼就停下
cautions.en: Stop if your neck tingles, hurts, or you feel dizzy.

flare2.item: 热身 v2-2：站姿颈-腕-指唤醒 45 秒（表：十指交扣腕绕 8 字；动画改合掌）
flare2.camera: 正前略偏右（看得到头部绕环和手部）
flare2.note: Animation r2: one 21 s loop = neck half rolls (no extension) 0-6.6 s, palms-together wrist figure-8 6.6-14.6 s (r2 fallback from the brief interlaced fingers, which read as crossed wrists in the sandbox close-ups), fist / spread x3 14.6-21 s. Head and finger motion are V5-only (v5r2-ext.js).

set.zh: 脖子只在前面半圈绕，不往后仰
set.en: Half circles in front only, never tip back

set.zh: 耳朵找肩膀，下巴经过胸口
set.en: Ear to shoulder, chin past the chest

set.zh: 双手合掌，手腕画横着的 8 字
set.en: Palms together, wrists draw a sideways eight

set.zh: 握拳握紧，张开时手指撑到最大
set.en: Tight fist, fingers spread wide after

set.zh: 肩膀放松往下，别耸起来
